fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons consumed in 2003, for every one dollar increase in the price of crude oil, our annual fuel expense would increase by approximately $35 million (implies ~1,470 million gallons consumed in 2003). Mainline fuel consumption was down 3.0% from 2002.

instrument_type_details.notes: As of December 31, 2003, did not have any fuel hedges in place (compared to 23% of projected 2003 requirements hedged at December 31, 2002). Company had Q1 2003 call options that expired by this date.

warnings: No fuel hedges in place at December 31, 2003.
